name: ablearc
description: Persistent evidence-driven learning workflows backed by the AbleArc Learning Kernel.

interface.longDescription: AbleArc helps ChatGPT teach from a persistent learner model, choose one useful cognitive move at a time, preserve evidence across sessions, and verify learning through retrieval, application, and transfer.
defaultPrompt: Continue what I was learning last time.
Teach me this topic, but make me do the important reasoning.
Test whether I still understand this without reviewing it first.
